analysis.subject: history
analysis.pageCoverage: Page covers issuance and purpose of proclamation as military measure, its scope limits, transformation of war character and expanded service by Black soldiers and sailors seeking liberty

overview.headline: Proclamation shifted war aims and expanded freedom through military measure

keyPoints.point: Southern secession prompted Northern fight to preserve Union without initially targeting slavery for removal
keyPoints.quote: Initially, the Civil War between North and South was fought by the North to prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union.

keyPoints.point: Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation issued by President Lincoln changed stated policy for states still in rebellion
keyPoints.quote: That changed on September 22, 1862, when President Lincoln issued his Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation

keyPoints.point: Military measure applied only to seceded states while leaving slavery untouched in loyal border states
keyPoints.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.

keyPoints.point: Proclamation acceptance enabled Black men to join Union Army and Navy as liberators expanding military strength
keyPoints.quote: the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators

keyTerms.gloss: withdrawal of Southern states from Union that prompted initial war to preserve Union
keyTerms.quote: Initially, the Civil War between North and South was fought by the North to prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union.

keyTerms.gloss: Confederate regions still in rebellion where persons held as slaves were declared free
keyTerms.quote: "that all persons held as slaves" within the rebellious areas "are, and henceforward shall be free."

keyTerms.gloss: loyal slaveholding states where slavery was left untouched by limited military measure
keyTerms.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.

keyTerms.gloss: Union victory that preceded decision to change war goals through military measure
keyTerms.quote: Lincoln’s bold step to change the goals of the war was a military measure and came just a few days after the Union’s victory in the Battle of Antietam

keyTerms.gloss: military branches that accepted Black men enabling liberated people to become liberators
keyTerms.quote: the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators
